gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the QNAP TS-464 (Celeron N5095), the Asustor Nimbustor 2 Gen2 AS5402T (Celeron N5105) and the Synology DS225+/DS425+ (Celeron J4125) have CPUs that Intel lists with SSE4.2 only and no AVX or AVX2, which puts them outside the hardware Frigate's docs say should work ('an Intel CPU (with AVX + AVX2 instructions)'). The UGREEN DXP4800 Plus at $619.99 and the TerraMaster F4-425 Pro (N350) at $699.99 on their makers' stores do sit on that list, because they use Gracemont/Alder Lake chips with AVX2.
standout_why: I compared this against docs.frigate.video/frigate/hardware/ (cited in all 7 chats), which gives the AVX + AVX2 rule but names no NAS, and against docs.frigate.video/frigate/installation/, which covers QNAP's 64 MB shm limit and its command-line install but says nothing about the CPU instruction set. ChatGPT turned the rule into a vague hedge in one chat ('Some older NAS processors may not meet these requirements') and still recommended the N5095 TS-464 in 4 of 7 chats. It also showed an Asustor AS6704T card. Our own current page lists the TS-464, AS5402T and DS225+ as OpenVINO-capable, which is the same mistake. None of these pages matches each candidate's CPU to Intel's instruction-set listing.
decides: This rules out the QNAP TS-464, the Asustor AS5402T and the Synology DS225+/DS425+ as 'run Frigate on the NAS' picks under Frigate's own stated hardware rule, even though they have Quick Sync iGPUs. The Synology DS925+ meets the rule (Ryzen V1500B with AVX2) but has no iGPU, so it falls back to the CPU detector or a Coral USB. That leaves the AVX2 Intel boxes. On today's maker-store prices that means the UGREEN DXP2800 (N100, $389.99) for 2 bays, the UGREEN DXP4800 Plus (Pentium Gold 8505, $619.99) as the 4-bay pick, and the DXP4800 Pro ($679.99) or TerraMaster F4-425 Pro (N350 8-core, 16 GB, $699.99) for more headroom. The F4-425 Pro costs $70–140 more on TerraMaster's own store today than the $629.99 and $559.99 ChatGPT showed for it. The page should present the rule as Frigate's documented requirement, not as a measured failure, because I did not find a named report of Frigate crashing on an N5095 or J4125.

findings.label: Frigate CPU requirement
findings.value: "Anything with an Intel CPU (with AVX + AVX2 instructions) and capable of running Debian should work fine"
findings.note: The same page says the Coral is no longer recommended for new installs, names the Beelink EQ13 (N100), and lists N100 at ~15 ms MobileNetV2 with only one detector instance and N150 at ~15 ms. It names no NAS models.

findings.label: QNAP and Synology install caveats
findings.value: QNAP Container Station has a fixed 64 MB shm and no GHCR support, so Frigate must be installed from the command line. Synology DSM 7 needs 'Execute container using high privilege'. Frigate needs about 210 MB shm for 2 cameras at 720p.
findings.note: The page says nothing about UGREEN UGOS or TerraMaster TOS.

findings.note: Why it loses: it falls outside Frigate's AVX+AVX2 rule, and its Container Station install is command-line only.
